title: Persuasive Sentence Ladder - School Nature Garden
h1: 🌿 Persuasive Sentence Ladder - School Nature Garden
hp: Copy it in your book or type it on screen, then expand and improve one persuasive sentence at a time.
h2: Build a persuasive sentence about school gardens from Level 1 to Level 3
intro: Tap a level to reveal it, then copy the sentence into your book or into the box. Students can compare how each version becomes more convincing.

levels.label: Level 1: Opinion
levels.say: Level 1. Copy the opinion into your book or into the box.
levels.text: We should plant a greener garden at our school.
levels.ans: We should plant a greener garden at our school.

levels.label: Level 2: Add a reason
levels.say: Level 2. Copy the sentence, then add a reason.
levels.text: We should plant a greener garden at our school because it will attract native animals and bugs.
levels.ans: We should plant a greener garden at our school because it will attract native animals and bugs.

levels.label: Level 3: Add persuasive language
levels.say: Level 3. Copy the sentence, then add persuasive language.
levels.text: We definitely must plant a greener garden at our school because it will attract fascinating native animals and helpful bugs.
levels.ans: We definitely must plant a greener garden at our school because it will attract fascinating native animals and helpful bugs.

levels.label: Full Sentence: Fully persuasive sentence
levels.say: Copy the fully persuasive sentence into your book or into the box.
levels.text: We definitely must plant a greener, native garden at our school, rather than just empty grass, because it will attract fascinating native animals and helpful bugs to our environment.
levels.ans: We definitely must plant a greener, native garden at our school, rather than just empty grass, because it will attract fascinating native animals and helpful bugs to our environment.

bh: Challenge: Put the persuasive sentence back together
bsay: Challenge. Put the words in order to make the persuasive sentence.
bsmall: Tap the chips in order to build the fully expanded sentence.
ans: We definitely must plant a greener, native garden at our school, rather than just empty grass, because it will attract fascinating native animals and helpful bugs to our environment.
